prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 phone-camera frame from a cluttered desk in a cramped spare-room home studio. A masked presenter leans into the lens mid-rant, one gloved finger jabbing at the camera, slightly soft in the foreground, the other hand flung open beside his head. His head is a midnight-blue merino balaclava, fine rib knit with crown decreases and a loose thread at the temple, one continuous knitted surface over the whole face, tucked into a charcoal roll-neck. A cream felt ring is appliquéd around the face with a visible running stitch; a small solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it at two o'clock, on the right side of the frame. Plain black leather gloves. Behind him: a crooked foam panel, an ironing board, a laundry basket, a glass of red wine on a shelf. The only light is grey daylight from a window at frame left. Wide phone lens, off-centre. Thanks.
